purpose: Acquire the exact same 2026-07-20..22 authoritative BRTI period, preserve the full subsecond history envelopes, and project the official one-second stream by timestamp boundary rather than row position.

pre_v3_information.v2_observed_payload_counts_only: Usually 18000 rows/hour; nine hours slightly below 18000.

official_contract.per_second_semantics: PER_SECOND returns only values at second boundaries.
official_contract.per_200ms_semantics: PER_200MS returns all ticks including those between second boundaries.
official_contract.projection_rule: Select a historical row if and only if time_ms modulo 1000 equals zero. Never select every fifth row or use row position.

download.hour_start_rule: Every integral UTC hour from first_hour_start_utc through last_hour_start_utc inclusive.

raw_envelope_validation_and_storage.order: After a 200 response, validate the raw envelope structure and every time/value row, then persist the complete unprojected response as deterministic gzip and record body/gzip/payload hashes. Only after persistence run the one-second projection check.
raw_time_rules: All source times are unique and strictly ascending.
All source times lie in the requested half-open UTC hour.
All source times lie on the 200ms grid relative to the Unix epoch.
All values are finite positive numerics.
raw_envelope_validation_and_storage.storage: Complete raw Kalshi envelope, deterministic gzip mtime=0; no individual value in console or receipt.

per_second_projection_validation.required_grid: Exactly hour_start+k*1000 for k=0..3599, once each and in ascending order.
per_second_projection_validation.failure: Any missing, duplicate, off-grid, or extra second-boundary row fails the full acquisition. Raw envelopes remain as hashed evidence but the model analyzer must not run.

hard_guards: Never issue a history request whose timestamp is 2026-07-23 or later.
Only a first-attempt HTTP 429 or 503 may receive one retry, after fixed 3000ms backoff and the shared attempt-start limiter.
No redirect, network-error retry, proxy substitution, interpolation, later-period fill, or partial analysis is permitted.
Never call recent /cfbenchmarks/values as a substitute.
Never print or persist credentials, signatures, auth timestamps, private-key paths, or individual BRTI values in console/receipt.
If any of 72 hours fails raw validation or exact one-second projection, calibration is NO_DECISION and the analyzer must not run.

calibration_contract.sigma60: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 60s.
calibration_contract.sigma300: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 300s.
calibration_contract.settlement_crosscheck: Require exactly 60 projected one-second BRTI values in [close-60s,close), compute their mean, and require (mean>=floor_strike) to equal official result.
calibration_contract.book_updates: Snapshot replaces; signed delta adds; never clamp or repair.

deployment: No acquisition or calibration result authorizes trading, engine mutation, or parameter change.
